definitions.short: baldness in the forehead; by analogy, a bare spot on the right side of cloth
definitions.full: H1372. gabbachath גַּבַּ֫חַת noun feminine bald forehead (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic ), only Leviticus 13 — absolute Lev 13:42 (P; asson. בַגַּבַּ֫חַת אוֺ בְּקָרַ֫חַת ); גַּבַּחְתּוֺ 13:42 ; 13:43 (both P & || קָרַחְתּוֺ ); in all, as place of appearance of an eruption; 13:55 (P; || id.) = in its front , i.e. front of garment. גֹּבַי see below גבה . סַלָּ֑י גַּבַּי גַּבַּי, see below גבב .
